$comment: Agent skills that `zaun install` (module `skills`) installs globally with the skills CLI (https://skills.sh).
source: a GitHub owner/repo (or any source `npx skills add` accepts).
skills: which skills from that source; omit to install all of them.
agents: skills CLI agent ids; default ["claude-code", "codex"]. All ids: https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills#supported-agents
Each entry runs: npx -y skills add <source> -g -y -a <agent> ... [-s <skill> ...]
Your own list goes in ~/.zaun-local/skills.json (same format); it is appended to this one.
